page.layout: One page of text, single column, with a running head at the top, a place-and-date line below the text, and a signature-like numeral "XXV." at the lower right. No margin notes.

main_text.p: varrent voluntatem & postulata ex-plicem, ex mandatorum scilicet eo-rum ratione & serie, quæ prolixio-ra ad Majestatem V. mihi tradita sunt. Quæ cum in adventum usque meum in vestram Aulam retinere decreverim, interea tamen literas Regias & nostras ad Serenitatem V. mittendas esse censui, ut certissima essent pignora instituendæ profectio-nis meæ ad Serenitatem vestram, quam ut Deus Opt. Max. ad Eccle-siæ suæ Salutem incolumem diutissi-me fervet, ardentibus votis exopto.

page.notes: Page number and running head read from the scan; the numeral "XXV." at lower right is set apart from the text and is given as a paragraph. Some letters in the running head and dateline are heavily inked and uncertain, notably the place name "Hamburgi" and the year "1594", which are marked as read. Scan contains scattered specks, not transcribed.
